title: Robots and Cars of the Future
text:
In the future, robots will help people at home. A robot can clean the floor and cook dinner. Some robots can also talk to children and read them stories. Many people think this will make life easier.

Cars will also change a lot. Many new cars will drive by themselves, with no driver. This will be safer because computers do not get tired or angry. Some people are still afraid of this new technology.

questions.text: What can a robot do at home, according to paragraph one?
options: Clean the floor and cook dinner

questions.text: What will be safer, according to paragraph two?
What is the writer's opinion about robots in the future?
options: Robots will be useful and make life easier
Robots are dangerous and should be banned
Robots will never be used in homes
Robots are only good for children

questions.text: What can we infer about some people's feelings about new technology?
options: They want to stop all new technology
They have never seen a robot
They are not yet sure it is safe
They think cars are too slow

vocabulary.definition: a machine that can do some jobs by itself
machines and tools made using science
a person who drives a car
less likely to cause harm or danger

paragraph_translations: W przyszłości roboty będą pomagać ludziom w domu. Robot może sprzątać podłogę i gotować obiad. Niektóre roboty potrafią też rozmawiać z dziećmi i czytać im bajki. Wielu ludzi uważa, że to ułatwi życie.

Samochody też bardzo się zmienią. Wiele nowych samochodów będzie jeździć samodzielnie, bez kierowcy. To będzie bezpieczniejsze, ponieważ komputery nie męczą się i nie denerwują. Niektórzy ludzie nadal boją się tej nowej technologii.
